properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: Ed25519 (EdDSA over Curve25519) is implemented inside the pinned direct dependency @noble/curves@2.2.0 (package.json:23) and ships in the build's node_modules. ethereum-cryptography does not re-export it through its own modules, so it is available-but-uncalled from this application's API. Quantum-vulnerable signature (Shor breaks the discrete log); migration ML-DSA-65. Changeable only by bumping/replacing @noble/curves.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: P-256 (secp256r1) ECDSA/ECDH is implemented inside the pinned direct dependency @noble/curves@2.2.0 and ships in the build's node_modules; ethereum-cryptography does not re-export it through its own modules. Quantum-vulnerable (Shor); migration ML-DSA-65 for signatures / ML-KEM-768 for key agreement, depending on consumer use. Changeable only by bumping/replacing @noble/curves.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: First-party Keccak/SHA-3 wrappers: src/keccak.ts exports keccak224/keccak256/keccak384/keccak512 (wrapHash over @noble/hashes sha3.js) — note keccak256 is the pre-FIPS-202 original-padding variant Ethereum relies on, not SHA3-256. The package.json sites (keyword "keccak", export-map entries ./keccak) declare the module the library ships. SHA-3 family is Grover-square-root only — low urgency; no migration needed beyond CNSA 2.0's SHA3-384 preference for 128-bit quantum security margin.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: First-party PBKDF2 wrapper: src/pbkdf2.ts exports pbkdf2()/pbkdf2Sync() over @noble/hashes, restricted to HMAC-SHA256/HMAC-SHA512, with iteration count and keylen caller-supplied (no fixed count in the wrapper — the BIP39 path that fixes 2048 is reported separately). package.json sites are the export map and keyword. PBKDF2 is symmetric-key KDF: quantum impact is Grover-only, urgency is in the iteration counts chosen by callers.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: First-party BLAKE2b wrapper: src/blake2b.ts exports blake2b(msg, outputLength=64) over @noble/hashes blake2.js with variable 1–64 byte digest length (default 64 = BLAKE2b-512); package.json sites are the export map and keyword. BLAKE2b is a modern hash — Grover-square-root only, no quantum urgency.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: First-party scrypt wrapper: src/scrypt.ts exports scrypt()/scryptSync() over @noble/hashes scrypt.js with N/r/p/dkLen caller-supplied (no fixed cost parameters in the wrapper). package.json sites are the export map and keyword. scrypt is memory-hard, Grover-only; caller cost parameters decide its strength.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-256 in the secp256k1-compat test suite: Node's crypto.createHash('sha256') at test/test-vectors/secp256k1-compat.ts:86 is the reference hashfn the tests use to verify secp.ecdh's default X-coordinate hashing (secp.ecdh hashes the shared X with sha256). Real SHA-256 computation in a test. The library's production SHA-256 module src/sha256.ts (wrapHash of @noble/hashes sha256) is covered by no roster object and is reported as a separate finding.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: SHA-256 is implemented inside the pinned direct dependency @noble/hashes@2.2.0 (package.json:24) and is consumed by this library's own modules — src/sha256.ts (reported separately), src/pbkdf2.ts (HMAC-SHA256 digest), and src/secp256k1-compat.ts (ECDH hashfn). Ships with the build. Grover-square-root only; CNSA 2.0 prefers SHA-384 for a 192-bit quantum margin.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: AES-GCM is implemented inside the pinned direct dependency @noble/ciphers@2.2.0 (package.json:22) and ships in the build's node_modules, but this library re-exports only CBC and CTR (src/aes.ts) — AES-GCM is available-but-uncalled from ethereum-cryptography's own API. It is the AEAD a remediation of the unauthenticated CTR default would use. AES-256-GCM retains a 128-bit quantum margin (Grover), so it is PQ-acceptable.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Crypto provider asset: @noble/ciphers@2.2.0 pinned as a direct dependency (package.json:22) and actively used — src/aes.ts imports cbc and ctr from it; it is the symmetric-cipher layer of the shipped library. Version 2.2.0 provides AES-CBC/CTR/GCM/SIV/ChaCha20-Poly1305 and no post-quantum algorithms (symmetric crypto needs only AES-256/GCM-class strength against Grover). Changeable here by bumping the pin.
